title: Jin Tae‑Kyung trapped in a game after a faulty logout
caption:
He finally discovers the system won’t let him escape… 😱

Part 1. Follow for Part 2!

#loginmurim #manhwa #manhwarecap #manga #recap #fyp
comment: What will Jin do now that reality and the game blur? 🤔

segments.say: *Suddenly* the screen flashes red, warning that the player cannot log out.
Jin Tae‑Kyung stares at the message, heart pounding, *realizing* his mistake.
He had only tried to log out after three days of endless *grinding*.
The manual he found earlier now feels like a cursed *guide*.
His mind races back to the *moment* the portal first opened.
Monsters poured from the *gates*, humanity rallied, hunters rose.
Jin, a low‑ranked hunter, barely *scraped* by with odd jobs.
His *brother*’s voice echoed, “TAE‑KYUNG, my bro… it seems you’re missing.”
He *laughed* it off, “But still… I need more.”
Drunk *memories* blur, “Huh? I did? When? Was I drunk?”
He was already *fired* from his last gig, no prospects left.
“I became a hunter *because* my late father was one,” he mutters.
The ARK‑2020 console whines, its warning lights blinking *ominously*.
“*Whatever*,” he sighs, “I’m just going to sleep now.”
The next morning, the manual’s warning repeats, *unchanging*.
He flips through the *user* manual, hoping for a solution.
“Why did someone put a user’s manual in an *interface*?” he wonders.
He tries the logout *command* again, but the system refuses.
“It’s *impossible* to logout,” the screen declares coldly.
*Frustration* builds as he watches the timer tick endlessly.
He hears a distant *voice* from the game’s tutorial system.
“Master Jin! Puha ha! *Welcome*!” the system jeers.
The tutorial quest begins, forcing him to accept a *mission*.
He *follows* the prompts, “Open Quest Menu!” the UI blares.
His character level rises to ten, a *son* of noble lineage.
The system boasts, “You are the son of a noble, *shameful*!”
Jin feels a pang of *guilt* remembering his family’s fall.
He decides to focus on survival, points *allocated* carefully.
“Let’s put 30 into stamina,” he mutters, eyes *narrowed*.
A sudden glitch flashes, “THIS IS…!!” the screen *glitches* wildly.
He hears a distant roar, the *monster* horde approaching.
“We were finally able to put an end to the great…,” the *narration* cuts off.
Jin’s HUD alerts, “Six of them…?” a group of *bandits* appears.
He equips the Keen Spear, rank: second‑rate, *restriction* noted.
“I’m a rank F hunter, the fight is *familiar*,” he thinks.
The battle erupts, his spear *clashing* against armored foes.
A critical hit lands, blood *splatters*, “DING!” the screen shouts.
He *eliminates* the last bandit, breath ragged, eyes wide.
The system *congratulates*, “You have completed the tutorial!”
A new quest *appears*, “Find a way to log out,” ominous text.
Jin’s mind *spirals*, “How many times must I repeat this?”
He recalls the *warning* about time manipulation limits.
“Time *manipulation*?” he whispers, hoping for a hidden cheat.
He checks his inventory, finds a *mysterious* capsule labeled “Junk.”
He hesitates, then opens it, hoping for a *key*.
*Nothing* happens, only a flash of static and a bitter curse.
“FUCK!! I don’t know anymore!!” he yells, voice *cracking*.
His level jumps to eleven, new *abilities* unlocked, but no exit.
He distributes points, focusing on *strength* and endurance.
A new NPC appears, a *mysterious* old man with a calm smile.
“You’re quite *interesting*, fellow,” the old master says.
He offers to teach Jin a secret technique, “Qi *circulation*.”
Jin *listens*, the ancient verses echoing in his mind.
The system *notifies*, “You have unlocked the main quest.”
A final *message* flashes, “Young master, we have arrived at the Jin family.”
Jin’s heart stops; the game has *recognized* his true lineage.
He feels a cold hand on his *shoulder*, the old master’s grin widening.
“Now, the real test begins,” the master *whispers*, eyes glowing.
A portal opens behind them, swirling with *dark* energy.
Jin steps *forward*, unsure if it leads home or deeper danger.
The screen blurs, the *tutorial* voice fades, leaving only silence…
He turns to the old man, but he has *vanished* without a trace.
A single line of code appears, “Are you ready to accept the *truth*?”
Jin *clenches* his fists, breath shallow, as the choice looms.
The *decision* button flickers, waiting for his final input…
